directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

preserve: publish moves pending/<id>.mp4 and its still by rename only after ffprobe reads one video stream of the frame size, one audio stream and the preview range's length

watch refuses a preview the rendered-video check has not measured after it was made, runs the content gate for the option and refuses on its unanswered or failed rows, then hard-links under the spec's watch name with link_into (never leaving the temporary link)
allowed_deltas: the content gate is the settings' command (and its absence refuses watch unless the settings say it is not required) where it was a path in the film repository; the frame size and tolerance are settings; one JSON request (action publish or watch) in place of argv
banned_substitutions: a film's folders, option ids, watch-folder names or the person's name written into the code
a second copy of the overlay renderer (the overlay step calls tool:render-a-motion-graphics-overlay)
an edit of the person's graded project other than FilmCraft's own headless commands on a copy
